properties.name: corlex:scope
properties.value: Reviewed SwiftPM SDK and build-only Tools manifests; no external SwiftPM package dependencies. Empty components is not a claim about the whole host application.

properties.name: corlex:platform-frameworks
properties.value: AppTrackingTransparency, CoreFoundation, CryptoKit, Darwin, Foundation, ObjectiveC, SwiftUI and UIKit are Apple platform frameworks, not vendored package sources. CCorlexCrash is owned SDK source under the same MIT license.

properties.name: corlex:validation
properties.value: SDK/Tools SwiftPM manifests have no external package dependencies;76 exact Foundation client/ledger tests and real C/Swift main-thread preparation own/host ASan probes pass. Full hosted iOS suite, native writer/exception/rearm and transport gates are required on this exact public revision before release.
